editorial.blurb: Moon Palace Express delivers solid Chinese comfort food with a focused menu and genuine hits like their xiao long bao and wide rice noodles.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit the lunch specials for $8–9 that include soup—great value in Chinatown—and skip the crab rangoons, but definitely order the shredded pork with chives and tofu.
signatureDishes: Shredded pork with chives and tofu
